characterList.description: A stoic samurai with a distinctive square jaw, black hair tied in a topknot, and piercing red eyes. He wears a red gi and wields a katana.

characterList.name: Boo-Boo Bear

characterList.description: A boy genius with orange hair, round glasses, and a white lab coat.
characterList.name: Dexter

characterList.description: Dexter's older sister with blonde hair and a pink dress. She's known for wreaking havoc in Dexter's lab.
characterList.name: Dee Dee

characterList.description: A tall, lanky boy with a black beanie and a jawbreaker always in his mouth.
characterList.name: Edd

characterList.description: A short, stocky boy with a unibrow and a love for gravy and buttered toast.
characterList.name: Ed

characterList.name: Eddy

characterList.description: A farm boy with a foreign accent, blonde hair, and a green shirt. He often shares stories of his old country.
characterList.name: Rolf
